pr_title: Adicionar funcao de limpeza de auditoria
pr_body: Adiciona limpar_auditoria para remover registros antigos e manter performance.
diff:
--- a/src/core/database.py
+++ b/src/core/database.py
@@ -820,6 +820,18 @@ class Database:
         self.conn.commit()
 
+    def limpar_auditoria(self, limite: int = 1000) -> int:
+        """Remove registros de auditoria mais antigos."""
+        self.cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auditoria")
+        total = self.cursor.fetchone()[0]
+        if total > limite:
+            self.cursor.execute(
+                "DELETE FROM auditoria WHERE id NOT IN "
+                "(SELECT id FROM auditoria ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?)",
+                (limite,)
+            )
+            self.conn.commit()
+            return total - limite
+        return 0
